source: Piaget stages, Montessori practical life, WHO/UNICEF early childhood guidelines. Home activities, not a clinical program.

ageBands.label: Toddlers & preschool
ageBands.science: Neuroplasticity peak for language, motor, and sensory maps. Preoperational play plus Montessori practical life.

ageBands.label: Early elementary
ageBands.science: Concrete-operational thinking. Executive function grows with rules, sequencing, and shared play.

ageBands.label: Upper elementary & pre-teens
ageBands.science: Identity and autonomy. Whole-child work: projects, empathy, discipline, and emotional regulation.

infant.cue: Under 2: serve-and-return, rhythm, and floor play. Skip BMI cuts.

under.cue: Needs extra energy: keep outdoor play and cooking. This is growth fuel, not a diet.

healthy.cue: Rotate cognitive, physical, social, and creative — one featured task a day.

watch.cue: Lead with movement and outdoor time. Veg, water, and play — never a restriction plan.

high.cue: More active play and team games. Mindfulness after movement. Nutrient quality, not restriction.

activities.name: Storytelling & picture books
activities.why: Builds language, imagination, and empathy (WHO responsive caregiving).
activities.todayTask: Read one picture book. Pause on two pages and ask “how does the character feel?”
activities.infantTask: Hold the book, name 5 pictures, and wait for a babble or point.

activities.name: Sorting & matching games
activities.why: Early numeracy and pattern recognition (Piaget preoperational; Montessori sensorial).
activities.todayTask: Sort 8 socks or spoons by colour/size. Let them check the last pair.
activities.infantTask: Offer two cups: big and small. Name “this one, that one.”

activities.name: Music & rhythm play
activities.why: Auditory processing and working memory. Rhythm scaffolds language.
activities.todayTask: Clap a 1-2-1-2 pattern to a song. Freeze when the music stops.
activities.infantTask: Pat a steady beat on the back during one lullaby.

activities.name: Outdoor free play
activities.why: Gross motor, balance, and vestibular input (WHO 180 min/day movement for 1–4 years, including active play).
activities.todayTask: Park or terrace: run, climb one safe object, then water. No screens until after.
activities.infantTask: Outdoor air on a mat. Tummy time facing a moving leaf or cloth.

activities.name: Art with large tools
activities.why: Fine motor control and hand-eye coordination before pencil grip.
activities.todayTask: Chunky crayon or chalk rangoli dots on big paper. Name the colours.
activities.infantTask: Finger-paint yogurt on a tray (taste-safe) for 3 minutes.

activities.name: Hands-on science experiments
activities.why: Cause-effect and hypothesis talk in the concrete-operational years.
activities.todayTask: Vinegar + baking soda in a cup. Guess first: will it fizz more with warm water?

activities.name: Board games & strategy play
activities.why: Logic, turn-taking, and frustration tolerance — executive function with rules.
activities.todayTask: One short board or card game. Loser chooses the next song, not a rematch argument.

activities.name: Coding with visual blocks (Scratch Jr)
activities.why: Computational thinking: sequence, loop, debug — age-fit, not adult syntax.
activities.todayTask: Make a sprite walk to a fruit and say one word. If it fails, change one block only.

activities.name: Cooking simple recipes
activities.why: Measuring (math), sequencing, and independence. Ties to the family meal planner.
activities.todayTask: Help measure 1 cup poha or 2 idlis’ worth of batter. Child plates the fruit.

activities.name: Team sports
activities.why: Cooperation, discipline, and cardio health. Social rules under movement.
activities.todayTask: 15 minutes kho-kho, cricket catch, or football pass. Water first. Then praise effort.

activities.name: Project-based learning
activities.why: Autonomy and deep work. Build → explain → revise (identity via competence).
activities.todayTask: 20 minutes on one project: a model, a 5-slide talk, or a mini research note. End with “what I still wonder.”

activities.name: Foreign language exposure
activities.why: Cognitive flexibility and memory. Dual-language homes already have a head start.
activities.todayTask: Learn 5 food words in a second language (or mother tongue script) and use two at dinner.

activities.name: Music instrument training
activities.why: Executive function, delayed gratification, and auditory-motor maps.
activities.todayTask: One scale or one song section. Record 30 seconds. Replay once — no perfection talk.

activities.name: Community service activities
activities.why: Empathy, responsibility, civic identity — not resume padding.
activities.todayTask: One real help: pack a tiffin for a neighbour, water a plant on the street, or sort recycling.

activities.name: Mindfulness & journaling
activities.why: Emotional regulation and self-reflection. Pair with movement if the BMI band is watch/high.
activities.todayTask: 3 slow breaths after play, then two sentences: one glad, one hard. No body-shame prompts.
